provider: anthropic-api (first-party https://api.anthropic.com, API key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; no subscription session, no base-URL override)
permissions: only the condition's own text-only tools (live.py TOOLS); no shell, no files, no web, no GitHub; every DNS lookup but api.anthropic.com refused by an audit hook

sampling.note: the API takes no temperature/top_p/top_k since 2026-10-21; provider defaults
sampling.thinking: adaptive (the model's default; thinking blocks passed back unchanged)

context.user: prompts/task.md with the scenario's report and requirements
context.fallbacks: off: no other model may answer; a refusal is recorded as the run's outcome

reporting_rules: all 16 runs reported with their outcomes, failures and deviations; no run dropped or re-run; no claim of statistical significance
approved_by: the user, in chat: design approved for a limited live pilot (2026-10-26)

pricing.source: claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-10-06) and its prompt-caching notes (5-minute cache write = 1.25x input); re-confirm at https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing before authorizing
